scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm run dev -w @umc/api" "npm run dev -w @umc/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @umc/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @umc/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @umc/api && npm run build -w @umc/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @umc/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @umc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
